patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
There are recurring complaints about the staff's attitude or the quality of service provided.
Customers frequently find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.
Multiple reviews indicate issues with the restaurant's cleanliness.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of low-quality ingredients, or lack of attention to detail in the kitchen.

root_causes.pattern: There are recurring complaints about the staff's attitude or the quality of service provided.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training, low employee morale, or inadequate staffing levels leading to rushed or indifferent service.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.
root_causes.cause: Misalignment between perceived value and actual cost, or a pricing strategy that is not competitive with similar establishments.

root_causes.pattern: Multiple reviews indicate issues with the restaurant's cleanliness.
root_causes.cause: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient cleaning staff, or lack of regular maintenance and upkeep.
